cipher.name: KeyboardColumnShiftCipher
cipher.idea: A simple, highly intuitive substitution cipher based on shifting keys vertically on a standard QWERTY keyboard. Each letter is shifted to its immediate vertical neighbor below it in its respective keyboard column, wrapping around to the top of the same column. Case is preserved, and non-alphabetic characters (spaces, punctuation, digits) remain completely unchanged.
cipher.encrypt_rules:
We define 10 vertical columns on a standard QWERTY keyboard layout:
Column 1: Q -> A -> Z -> Q
Column 2: W -> S -> X -> W
Column 3: E -> D -> C -> E
Column 4: R -> F -> V -> R
Column 5: T -> G -> B -> T
Column 6: Y -> H -> N -> Y
Column 7: U -> J -> M -> U
Column 8: I -> K -> I (Since there is no letter below K, K wraps to I)
Column 9: O -> L -> O (Since there is no letter below L, L wraps to O)
Column 10: P -> P (P stays P as it has no letters below it in its column)

For any lowercase letter, find its column, shift to the next letter in the cycle, and output it in lowercase.
For any uppercase letter, find its column, shift to the next letter in the cycle, and output it in uppercase.
All other characters (digits, spaces, punctuation) remain completely unchanged.
cipher.decrypt_rules:
To decrypt, reverse the vertical shift (move to the neighbor above in the column cycle):
Column 1: Q -> Z -> A -> Q
Column 2: W -> X -> S -> W
Column 3: E -> C -> D -> E
Column 4: R -> V -> F -> R
Column 5: T -> B -> G -> T
Column 6: Y -> N -> H -> Y
Column 7: U -> M -> J -> U
Column 8: I -> K -> I
Column 9: O -> L -> O
Column 10: P -> P

For any lowercase letter, find its column, shift to the previous letter in the cycle, and output it in lowercase.
For any uppercase letter, find its column, shift to the previous letter in the cycle, and output it in uppercase.
All other characters (digits, spaces, punctuation) remain completely unchanged.
